o.en: Execute the grpck command in read-only mode. This causes all questions regarding changes to be answered no without user intervention.
Apply changes in the CHROOT_DIR directory and use the configuration files from the CHROOT_DIR directory. Only absolute paths are supported. No SELINUX support.
Sort entries in /etc/group and /etc/gshadow by GID.
Suppress more controversial warnings, in particular warnings about inconsistency between group members listed in /etc/group and /etc/ghadow.
